authorization.rule: Check the current caller against the finalizers group before reading the batch, review items, or source payloads.

candidate.visibility: Pending files and IDs are never exporter-visible; only an Approved batch is visible.
candidate.emptyBatchPolicy: Reject finalization of a zero-item batch; an empty Ready batch remains useful for materialization and paging tests.
candidate.order: SourceItemId ascending within a batch; corrections must follow their predecessors in source creation order.
candidate.included: Decision Approve and ValidationState Valid; every other decision blocks preparation except Exclude with a nonempty reason.
candidate.sourceRule: Reread every source row and require the captured SourceETag and complete concatenated SourcePayloadBase64A/B to match exactly.
candidate.draftRule: Use the saved complete DraftProjectionBase64A/B when present, otherwise the captured source bytes. Validate the resulting activity or status object against the accepted form contract before preparing it.
candidate.identityRule: Reuse SourceSubmissionId only when final serialized UTF-8 bytes equal the captured source bytes exactly. Otherwise persist one generated ApprovedSubmissionId on the review item with an item ETag conditional write, then reuse it on every retry.
candidate.ancestryRule: Rewrite revision.rootSubmissionId and revision.supersedesSubmissionId through source-to-approved mappings. A same-batch predecessor must be included and earlier; a prior-batch predecessor must resolve through an Approved batch. Excluded, missing, ambiguous, dangling, or cyclic ancestry blocks the candidate.
candidate.serialization: Preserve the exact source UTF-8 bytes when the object is unchanged. For changed objects, serialize once through the cloud-flow string function after applying approved IDs and rewritten ancestry; retain those exact bytes for readback.
candidate.digest: Use an explicitly non-cryptographic b64-edge-v1 fingerprint only for display and lookup. Exact comparisons use complete encoded bytes plus item ETags and versions; a fingerprint alone is never an integrity proof.
candidate.storage: Store candidate objects and a manifest under a non-public Pending/<batchId>/<candidateRunId> path in the restricted TEST ONLY approved-projection library. The manifest records exact payload base64, source and review ETags, draft versions, decisions, mappings, and counts. PA-37B must read exact candidate bytes and reject stale source or draft ETags/versions before freezing.
candidate.retry: A repeated request reuses every persisted ApprovedSubmissionId and returns the same candidate bytes for an unchanged source/draft/mapping snapshot in a new candidateRunId directory. A changed snapshot creates a separate pending candidate, never silently adopts new source bytes.

failure.rule: No candidate may set a batch to Approved. A failed or uncertain preparation leaves Ready or Failed with a bounded diagnostic and no exporter-visible payload.
cases: source count, ETag, or encoded-byte mismatch
missing, excluded, or cyclic correction predecessor
